description: At scale 2 (1.2 wide, 3.6 tall, eyes at 3.24): walking into a 3-high corridor (stopped by its roof), in crouching (3.0 fits exactly), sneak let go inside (it stays crouched), out and standing; a jump into a block's side (the step height stays 0.6); sneaking to the east edge of the block's top (backed off at the wider box's edge); set to 1 in mid-jump; under a 2-high ceiling set to 1.25 (it crouches) and 2 (it crawls), crawling out; a boat ridden at 2 (seated 0.6 lower than at 1: the player's vehicle point scales); at 1, a still zombie a block east set to 3, which pushes the player from the tick after the packet (its own tick takes in the size); set to 2 beside a wall the box then reaches into: pushed out of it; killed at 2 with its centre past a block's edge (the body stays: the server doesn't send the dying pose to the player itself); respawned keeping the base value, walking south into a wall (stopped 0.6 from it).

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
